description: This file provides functions for handling image uploads in a web application, including saving base64-encoded images and multipart form-data images to disk, with validation and filename sanitization.

methods.name: Path _storage_root()
methods.description: Determines the root directory for storing images, either from environment variable or default path.

methods.name: str _safe_filename(name: str)
methods.description: Sanitizes a filename, removing unsafe characters.

methods.name: str _new_object_name(original_name: Optional[str], content_type: str)
methods.description: Generates a unique filename for an image based on original name and content type.

methods.name: bytes _decode_base64(data: str)
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded string, supporting data URI scheme.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str] save_base64_image(*, defect_id: int, file_name: Optional[str], content_type: str, data_base64: str)
methods.description: Saves a base64-encoded image to disk under a defect-specific directory.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str,str,Optional[str]] save_multipart_image(*, defect_id: int, upload: UploadFile)
methods.description: Saves an image uploaded via multipart/form-data to disk under a defect-specific directory.
